mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to the prior three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic slack and reduced corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals a 'growth' regime that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (above 900 thousand units) signal a late-cycle expansion phase where economic growth is slowing and equity valuations are stretched, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with HOUST > 900.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High residential mortgage credit (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 400000.0 and UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
